tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: Your friend, Alex, has been feeling overwhelmed with university assignments. You have noticed that he is struggling to keep up with his workload and is not taking proper care of his health. You want to offer some helpful advice. Write an email to Alex.
bullets: Describe to Alex what you have recently noticed about him.
Explain why it is important to maintain good health.
Suggest some specific strategies Alex can use to manage his stress and workload.
tasks.subject: Managing stress and workload
